title: Top 5 LARGEST Galaxies In The Universe
hook: Number one could swallow millions of Milky Ways.

items.name: Andromeda Galaxy
items.stat: About 220,000 light-years wide, over twice the size of our Milky Way.

items.name: Comet Galaxy
items.stat: Its star-forming tail stretches roughly 600,000 light-years behind it.

items.name: Malin 1
items.stat: This giant low-surface-brightness spiral spans about 650,000 light-years across.

items.name: ESO 383-76
items.stat: This colossal elliptical galaxy measures roughly 1.7 million light-years wide.

items.name: IC 1101
items.stat: One of the largest known galaxies at up to 4 million light-years across.
